sources.title: IBM Support — Creating and assigning an authorization list

asciiPanel:
EDTAUTL                          Edit Authorization List                 CLAIMS400

Authorization list . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : PAYROLL

Type options, press Enter.
  4=Remove

Opt  User profile          Authority   List Mgt
     PAYADMIN              *ALL        *YES
     APCLERK               *USE        *NO

F3=Exit   F6=Add   F12=Cancel
notes: Requires *AUTLMGT or ownership. F6 adds users (ADDAUTLE); option 4 removes entries. *AUTLMGT in member list controls who can manage the AUTL itself.
